name: Terfenadine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 10 other countries, first in 1997 — for heart harm

summary: Terfenadine was removed from the market in the United States and ten other countries, beginning in 1997, due to harm it caused to the heart [3]. Based on predictions from a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a low score of 7 for liver issues and a high score of 78 for heart issues [M]. These automated computer ratings evaluate potential risks without using real patient data [M].
